name: work-log-stats
description: 工作日志统计系统 - 基于Web的轻量级日志管理工具

scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const files = ['index.html', 'app.js', 'chart.js', 'style.css', 'README.md', '示例数据.csv']; fs.mkdirSync('dist', { recursive: true }); files.forEach(file => { fs.copyFileSync(file, path.join('dist', file)); }); console.log('Build completed successfully.')"
